title: decision: leaf lists mimid built-ins plus the application's components
description: Supersedes mimid-krmn.8 (fixed list). Found in K5: with mls-extensions #110 rule 6 (dictionary components must be listed in GroupContext app_components) and rules 3-5 (every leaf must list them), a fixed leaf list makes a mimid Member unable to be in any group using a component outside it, although Member delegates component semantics to the caller's apply handler. Mark 2026-11-02: a leaf's app_components lists mimid's built-ins (0x0004, 0x0020-0x0029) plus any extra component ids the application declares when generating the Identity, plus one GREASE value; never 0x0001/0x0002. The extras are stored with the Identity so a reloaded identity keeps them.
